soundness_flags.label: prop:known-reductions, pure-entry reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed implication is false as written: with h0=a, M1={a,b}, M2={a,b,c}, tau>0, f1=b, f2(a)=a, and f2(b)=b, the a/b constraints require z_b-z_a>p1b-p1a+kappa and z_b-z_a<-(p2a-p2b+kappa), so this table is feasible for kappa<tau/2 but is not terminal-feasible.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 18–19, Theorem 2.3 and ‘Treatment of the data’
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2.3 gives stated probability inequalities, while the nonparametric treatment requires the choice set to be the same in the two compared periods.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 22, Assumption 2.13 and Proposition 2.14; pp. 23–24, Remark 2.17
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Under conditional iid shocks, the local probability bodies are closed and convex but not polytopes; the paper presents a support-function representation rather than a finite linear characterization.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article reduces discrete causal bounding problems to polynomial programs and supplies refining valid non-sharp bounds during incomplete computation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the pure-entry tau>=0 reduction with a complete cycle-based iff classification; at minimum, include the f1=b, f2(a)=a, f2(b)=b two-cycle as the first countercheck and state the correct sign and threshold regime.

Make the three-plan OEQ decisive by publishing one fully worked pure-entry class, including all zero-probability boundary cases and an attaining mixture, before claiming the all-class formula program.

State an explicit finite-menu certification algorithm with its input encoding, number of response tables/grid points, and rational-certificate complexity; this separates the useful computational result from generic polynomial optimization.

recommended_next_step: Revise the false pure-entry sanity reduction using the response-graph cycle calculation, then retain the terminal-frontier and analytic-elimination kernel for Stage 0.
